articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially launched GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and multi-step mathematical proofs, narrowing the gap on several AGI benchmarks. Enterprise API access is rolling out with new structured output guarantees and latency optimizations.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Reasoning Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on GPQA-Diamond, MathOdyssey, and a newly introduced scientific literature synthesis benchmark. The model incorporates a novel mixture-of-experts architecture with dynamic routing that reduces inference cost by roughly 40% compared to its predecessor. Google is integrating the model across Workspace, Cloud, and its research tools.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Figure announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robots have completed a 90-day pilot at a major logistics facility, autonomously handling pick-pack-ship workflows with 97.3% task completion rates. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for real-time object identification and grasp planning without pre-mapped environments. The company disclosed a $1.5B Series C to scale manufacturing to 10,000 units per year.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Commercial Deployment in Factories
articles.summary: Tesla began deploying Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots in its own Gigafactories and select partner manufacturing sites, performing repetitive assembly and materials-handling tasks alongside human workers. The new generation features improved actuator density, a 60% increase in battery endurance, and a transformer-based whole-body control policy trained end-to-end in simulation. Elon Musk stated the company aims for external commercial sales by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering: Fine-Grained Runtime Safety Controls for Claude
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Steering, a technique that allows enterprise customers to define domain-specific safety and behavior policies as declarative constraints enforced at inference time without fine-tuning. The approach uses a lightweight constitutional classifier that runs in parallel with generation, enabling per-request policy customization with under 8% latency overhead. The feature is available now in the Claude API for Teams and Enterprise tiers.

articles.title: ASML Ships First Production High-NA EUV Systems to Intel and Samsung
articles.summary: ASML confirmed the first production-grade High-NA EUV lithography systems have been delivered to Intel's Fab 52 in Ohio and Samsung's Pyeongtaek campus, enabling patterning at the 1.4nm logic node. The Twinscan EXE:5000 platform achieves 185 wafers per hour throughput, a critical milestone for economic viability. Industry analysts say this cements EUV's roadmap through the end of the decade and accelerates advanced chip availability for AI workloads.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving below-threshold error rates on logical qubit operations using their hybrid trapped-ion architecture with real-time quantum error correction. The team executed 100,000 consecutive logical CNOT gates with a logical error rate of 1e-6, a critical engineering milestone for practical quantum computing. Microsoft announced integration of the system into Azure Quantum for early research access.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Dexterous Manipulation for Construction
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed an updated electric Atlas platform with new five-fingered hands capable of tool use, developed in partnership with Hyundai's construction division. Live demonstrations showed the robot autonomously operating a drill, carrying irregularly shaped materials, and navigating active construction environments using LiDAR-vision fusion. The system is entering pilot deployments at three Hyundai E&C sites in South Korea this summer.
